ReliefCenters.description: Stores registered relief center details. Each center is a unique entity with contact info and location.

partitionKey.rationale: UUID assigned to each center. Guarantees unique lookups by center ID — the most common access pattern (get one center's details).

globalSecondaryIndexes.rationale: When a staff member logs in, we look up which center they manage. Query by staffEmail returns the center record directly.

attributes.name: String - center name
attributes.staffEmail: String - email of the staff member who manages this center (links to Users table)

Inventory.description: Tracks resource quantities per center. Uses composite key so each center has exactly one record per resource type.

partitionKey.rationale: Groups all resource types under one center. A Query on centerId returns the full inventory for that center in one call.

sortKey.rationale: Distinguishes food/water/medical/shelter within a center. Enables single-item lookups (GetItem) and updates (UpdateItem) for a specific resource.

globalSecondaryIndexes.rationale: Enables the admin to scan all critically low resources across ALL centers in one query. 'lowStock' is a boolean/string flag set by the Lambda when quantity < threshold.

attributes.threshold: Number - minimum quantity before alert triggers
attributes.lowStock: String - 'true' or 'false' - denormalized flag for GSI filtering

HelpRequests.description: Public help requests submitted by anyone. Each request is independent and tracked through its lifecycle.

partitionKey.rationale: UUID per request. Direct lookups when updating status or viewing a single request.

globalSecondaryIndexes.rationale: Admin dashboard needs requests sorted by urgency within a status (e.g., all 'pending' requests, highest urgency first). Composite sort on urgency (1=critical, 2=high, 3=medium, 4=low) gives natural ordering.
Admin can filter requests by geographic area and see which are still pending. Useful for regional disaster response coordination.

attributes.name: String - requester name
attributes.description: String - free text describing the need
attributes.assignedCenterId: String - UUID of assigned center (null until assigned)

Users.description: Stores user accounts for authentication. Maps to Cognito but also stored in DynamoDB for quick role lookups.

partitionKey.rationale: Email is the unique identifier for login. Direct GetItem by email to verify credentials and fetch role.

attributes.email: String - unique, used as login ID
attributes.passwordHash: String - bcrypt hash (in real app, Cognito handles this)
attributes.name: String - display name
attributes.centerId: String - FK to ReliefCenters (only for staff role)

designDecisions.whySingleTableDesignWasRejected: For a course project, separate tables are clearer to explain in a viva. Each table maps 1:1 to a concept (center, inventory, request, user). Single-table design is better at scale but harder to explain.
designDecisions.whyGSIonLowStock: The lowStock boolean flag is denormalized. When inventory is updated, the Lambda sets lowStock='true' if quantity < threshold. The GSI lets us query all low-stock items across all centers without scanning the entire Inventory table.
designDecisions.whyCompositeKeyOnInventory: centerId + resourceType means: (a) get full inventory for a center = 1 Query, (b) update a specific resource = 1 UpdateItem with exact key, (c) no duplicate resource types per center (DynamoDB enforces uniqueness of composite keys).
designDecisions.whyUrgencyIsNumber: DynamoDB sorts numbers numerically. urgency=1 (critical) sorts before urgency=4 (low) in ascending order, which is the natural priority order for the admin dashboard.
